name: UltraClear Laser
intro: A multi-application laser, with settings ranging from a gentle refresh through to more intensive resurfacing.
statement: A multi-application laser platform, with settings *from a gentle refresh to more intensive resurfacing.*
how: A single platform covering several depths, from a gentle refresh to deeper resurfacing, so fewer devices are needed to cover a full range of skin concerns.
outcomes: Improved texture and tone, tailored to the setting used
suits: Patients with pigmentation, redness or textural concerns suited to light or laser-based treatment.
notSuitable: Recent significant sun exposure, certain skin tones or conditions, active infection, or pregnancy.
assessed: Skin type, sun exposure history and the specific concern are reviewed before a course is planned.
before: Skin is cleansed and eye protection provided for the treatment.
during: The device is passed across the treatment area in controlled passes, adjusted for your skin type.
after: Redness and, depending on intensity, light peeling are expected for several days.
risks: Risks may include prolonged redness, pigment changes or, rarely, scarring; discussed in full at consultation.
